versions.name: Radio
versions.description: Chart the radio spectrum from kilohertz to microwaves, learn how signals bounce or stay local, then get on the air with an amateur contact, a broadcast log, a shortwave hunt, or a direction-finding fox hunt.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
